digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow adapters and core push integration
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to core push entrypoints instead of maintaining inline CAS/retry loops.
Workflow-local fetch, merge, and retry logic must be removed; core owns CAS recovery and workflow calls remain red on exhausted delivery failure.
Reconciler identity, commit subject, and author metadata must be preserved through the migration to core push.
Strict synchronous delivery behavior must be maintained; Python library and MCP interfaces retain best-effort defaults unchanged.
Raw-git reconciler exemption must be removed and test rationale updated to generic reviewed-workflow language.
Real-git workflow smoke tests must confirm successful delivery and rejected-push failure behavior after migration.
